Rashi on Chagigah 14a:10:1.hebrew: לחם אלו בעלי הש"ס - שיש לסמוך על הוראתן כסמיכת לחם:
Rashi on Chagigah 14a:10:1.english: Bread: these are the masters of the Talmud - For one may rely on their rulings, like the support of bread:

Rashi on Chagigah 14a:10:2.hebrew: בעל שמועות - ששמע הלכות פסוקות מרבותיו, ושגורות בפיו:
Rashi on Chagigah 14a:10:2.english: Master of traditions - One who heard definitive halakhot from his teachers, and they are fluent in his mouth.

Rashi on Chagigah 14a:10:3.hebrew: ראוי לישב בישיבה - וליטול ממנו עצה בכל דבר חכמה:
Rashi on Chagigah 14a:10:3.english: Fit to sit in the academy - And to take counsel from him in every matter of wisdom.

Rashi on Chagigah 14a:11:1.hebrew: כדרבי אבהו - להעמיד לפניו מתורגמן לדרוש ברבים:
Rashi on Chagigah 14a:11:1.english: In accordance with Rabbi Abbahu - to appoint before him a disseminator (meturgeman) to expound before the public.

Rashi on Chagigah 14a:11:2.hebrew: למעלה נושאין פנים בעבורו לדורו - שהכל ניזונין בזכותו, כגון רבי חנינא בן דוסא, כדאמרינן בעלמא (תענית דף כד:): כל העולם אינו ניזון אלא בשביל חנינא בני:
Rashi on Chagigah 14a:11:2.english: Above, favor is shown to his generation for his sake - For everyone is sustained in his merit, such as Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa, as we say elsewhere (Taanit 24b): The entire world is sustained only for the sake of My son Chanina.

Rashi on Chagigah 14a:11:3.hebrew: למטה - מלכי האומות מכבדין אותן בשבילו, כגון ר' אבהו שהיה חשוב בבית המלך, כדאמרינן במסכת סנהדרין (דף יד.): דהוו נפקי אמהתא דבי קיסר לאפיה כו':
Rashi on Chagigah 14a:11:3.english: Below - The kings of the nations honor them (the Jews) for his sake, such as Rabbi Abahu, who was esteemed in the king's house, as we say in tractate Sanhedrin (14a): that the maidservants of the emperor's household would go out to meet him, etc.

Rashi on Chagigah 14a:12:1.hebrew: שראוי למסור לו כו' - כגון אב"ד, לבו דואג בקרבו:
Rashi on Chagigah 14a:12:1.english: Who is worthy of having ... transmitted to him, etc. - For example, the head of a court (av beit din), whose heart is anxious within him.

Rashi on Chagigah 14a:15:1.hebrew: כי יתפש איש באחיו - הכתוב היה מגנן, לומר שלא היו יודעין להשיב לשואלים הלכה:
Rashi on Chagigah 14a:15:1.english: For a man shall take hold of his brother - The verse was disparaging them, to say that they did not know how to answer those who asked [them] a halachic question.

Rashi on Chagigah 14a:15:2.hebrew: שבני אדם מתכסין בהן - נחבאין, שלא ישאלו להן לפי שאין בקיאין בהן:
Rashi on Chagigah 14a:15:2.english: That people cover themselves with - They hide, so that they will not be asked about them, because they are not expert in them.

Rashi on Chagigah 14a:15:3.hebrew: ישנן תחת ידך - כלומר, אתה בקי בהן:
Rashi on Chagigah 14a:15:3.english: They are under your hand - That is to say, you are well versed in them.

Rashi on Chagigah 14a:16:1.hebrew: אא"כ נכשל בהם - כשהתלמיד נכשל בשמועתו פעם ראשונה ושניה, הוא נותן לב לעמוד על שמועתו:
Rashi on Chagigah 14a:16:1.english: Unless one has stumbled in them - When the student stumbles in his learning the first and second time, he pays attention to grasp what he has learned:

Rashi on Chagigah 14a:16:2.english: I will not be - I am not accustomed to being.

Rashi on Chagigah 14a:17:1.hebrew: דלמא - האי נמי לאו משום דאנשי אמנה היו, אלא דאי הוה אמר "גמירנא", הוו אמרי ליה: "אימא לן!" — והוא לא הוה ידע:
Rashi on Chagigah 14a:17:1.english: But perhaps - This too [his statement] was not because they were trustworthy people, but rather because, had he said, "I have learned," they would have said to him, "Tell us!" — and he did not know [it].

Rashi on Chagigah 14a:1:1.hebrew: קודם שנברא העולם - נגזר עליהם להבראות להיות קודם מתן תורה, לקיים מה שנאמר: ״דבר צוה לאלף דור״ (תהלים קה). ראויה היתה תורה להינתן לסוף אלף דור, וכשראה הקב״ה שאין העולם מתקיים בלא תורה, עמד וטרדן, ונתנה לסוף כ"ו דורות מאדם הראשון עד משה רבינו:
Rashi on Chagigah 14a:1:1.english: Before the world was created - It had been decreed that they be created, to be before the giving of the Torah, in fulfillment of what is stated: “He commanded His word for a thousand generations” (Psalms 105). The Torah was meant to be given at the end of a thousand generations; but when [God] saw that the world cannot endure without Torah, He arose and drove them off, and gave it at the end of twenty-six generations, from Adam the first man until Moses our teacher.

Rashi on Chagigah 14a:3:1.english: Great is Your faithfulness - Great is Your praise upon them.

Rashi on Chagigah 14a:5:1.english: His throne - This implies one throne.

Rashi on Chagigah 14a:5:2.hebrew: כרסון רמיו - שני כסאות הוטלו, נתקנו לישב עליהן:
Rashi on Chagigah 14a:5:2.english: Thrones were placed - Two thrones were set in place; they were prepared for sitting upon them.

Rashi on Chagigah 14a:5:3.english: [Making] the Divine Presence profane - By seating a person at His side.

Rashi on Chagigah 14a:6:1.hebrew: כלך מדברותיך - חדל מדבריך עד שתגיע אצל נגעים ואהלות, שהן הלכות עמוקות:
Rashi on Chagigah 14a:6:1.english: Depart from your words - Cease your statements until you arrive at Negaim and Oholot (the tractates on leprosy-plagues and on tents), for these are profound halakhot.

Rashi on Chagigah 14a:7:1.hebrew: קילל ישעיה את ישראל - כלומר, נתנבא עליהן י"ח פורעניות:
Rashi on Chagigah 14a:7:1.english: Isaiah cursed Israel - That is, he prophesied about them eighteen calamities.

Rashi on Chagigah 14a:7:2.english: They shall behave insolently - They shall act arrogantly.

Rashi on Chagigah 14a:9:1.hebrew: שש מאות סדרי משנה - אלו היו בימיהן:
Rashi on Chagigah 14a:9:1.english: Six hundred orders of Mishnah - These were [in existence] in their days:

Tosafot on Chagigah 14a:11:1.hebrew: רבי חנינא בן דוסא למעלה - שהיה בעל מעשים יותר מכל בני דורו:
Tosafot on Chagigah 14a:11:1.english: Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa [was favored] above - For he was a man of [wondrous] deeds, more than all of his contemporaries:

Tosafot on Chagigah 14a:11:2.hebrew: ולמטה בבית קיסר - ולאו משום שלא היה חשוב למעלה, אלא משום שגם בדורו היו אנשי מעשה כמותו:
Tosafot on Chagigah 14a:11:2.english: And below, in the house of the emperor - And [this is] not because he was not significant above, but because in his generation there were also men of deeds like him [who held favor above].

Tosafot on Chagigah 14a:1:1.hebrew: וטרדן - ואיכא למ"ד "ושתלן". פרש"י לפי לשון ראשון: נתן נשמתן בגיהנם, ולא נבראו. ותימה הוא, וכי עביד דינא בלא דינא? כי מה פשעו להיות בגיהנם? ונראה לפרש "וטרדן" — שלא נבראו ביחד, כי אם מעט לכל דור ודור, כדי שלא יחריבו העולם. ושני הלשונות בירושלמי שוה, אך הלשון משונה, ולכך לא חש למתני "איכא דאמרי לה בהאי לישנא", כיון שאינו משנה לה רק חדא תיבה:
Tosafot on Chagigah 14a:1:1.english: "And He drove them away" - And there is an opinion that reads "and He planted them." Rashi explained, according to the first version, that He placed their souls in Gehenna, and they were not created. But this is astonishing: Does He execute judgment without a trial? What was their offense that they should be in Gehenna? Rather, it appears to explain "and He drove them away" as meaning that they were not created all together, but only a few in each and every generation, so that they would not destroy the world. And both versions appear equally in the Yerushalmi. However, the [first] wording is unusual, and therefore [the Gemara] did not bother to teach "some say it in this wording," since it changes it by only a single word.

Tosafot on Chagigah 14a:3:1.hebrew: ופליג אר' שמואל בר נחמני - שהוא אומר שמלאכים נבראים בדבור של המקום, ולא מנהר דינור:
Tosafot on Chagigah 14a:3:1.english: And it disagrees with Rabbi Shmuel bar Naḥmani - for he says that angels are created through the speech of the Omnipresent, and not from the River Dinur:
